latest_release.name: Version 3.0.1
latest_release.body:
- Fix PHP requirement test after contact-form-7 started requiring WordPress 7.1 [[#560](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/560)]
- Use update check data to validate installed theme versions [[#559](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/559)]
- Honor `--ignore-requirements` for WordPress core package checks [[#558](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/558)]
- Fix update checks when `--skip-plugins` or `--skip-themes` is used [[#553](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/553)]
- Fix `update_unavailable_reason` leaking across rows in plugin and theme list [[#552](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/552)]
- Detect closed WordPress.org plugins [[#550](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/550)]
- Fix `wporg_last_updated` always being empty for active plugins [[#547](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/547)]
- Fix PHPCS errors in Behat test files [[#545](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/545)]
- Fix PHPStan errors with WordPress 7.1 stubs [[#544](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/544)]
- Fix `wp plugin list` fatal on WordPress < 5.3 and quiet the wp-compat false positives [[#543](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/543)]
- Fix plugin install detection when update info is unavailable [[#541](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/541)]
- Fix failing theme tests [[#540](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/540)]
- Fix newly reported PHPStan errors [[#539](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/539)]
- Update branch-alias to 3.x-dev [[#538](https://github.com/wp-cli/extension-command/pull/538)]
